9 + 3 - 72 × 6 ÷ 3 = ?
questions.solution:
By following the signs given in the question:

×

**Meaning**

 = 9 × 3 + 72 ÷ 6 - 3

questions.question:
In the question, a statement is given, followed by two arguments, I and II. You have to consider the statement to be true even if it seems to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given arguments, if any, is a strong argument.

**Statement:** Should speed breakers be banned?

**Argument I**: Yes, data shows that number of accidents increase after putting the speed breakers.

**Argument II:** No, it teaches fast drivers a lesson.

options.text: if only argument I is strong
if only argument II is strong.
if both I and II are strong.
if neither I nor II is strong.

questions.solution:
The given statement can strongly be supported by argument I because as per data number of accidents have increased after putting speed breakers, so they should be banned. Hence, argument I is strong.

Argument II is not a strong one as the purpose of speed breakers is not to teach any lesson to drivers but to make them slow down.

questions.question: If 19#13 = 3; 25#3 = 11; 36#10 = 13; then what is the value of 7#3 = ?
questions.solution:

In 36#10 = 13,

36 - 10 = 26 ÷ 2 = 13

The same pattern will be followed in 7#3 = ?

7 - 3 = 4 ÷ 2 = 2

Hence, answer is 2.

questions.question: Hansh's birthday is on Monday 5th June. On what day of the week will be Tushar's Birthday in the same year if Tushar was born on 11th December?
questions.solution:
The number of days between 5 June and 11 December is (25 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 +11) = 189 days.

A day repeats itself on the seventh day.

Thus, no. of weeks = 189 ÷ 7 = 27 weeks.

Hence, Tushar's birthday is on Monday.

questions.question: Who discovered Sodium?
questions.solution: Sodium was first isolated in 1807 by Humphry Davy, who made it by the electrolysis of very dry molten sodium hydroxide, NaOH. Sodium is the sixth most abundant element on earth and comprises about 2.6% of the earth's crust.

questions.question: _________ is the process of restoring a forest that once existed but was removed at some point of time in the past.
questions.solution: Reforestation is the process of restoring existing forests and woodland that have been depleted, usually through deforestation. Reforestation can be used to rectify or improve the quality of human life by soaking up pollution.

questions.question: Jama Masjid of Delhi was built in which century?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Mughal emperor Shah Jahan** built the **Jama Masjid** between **1644 and 1656**.
 
• It was originally called **Masjid-i-Jahan-Numa**, meaning '**mosque commanding view of the world**'.

**Note**__:

**Century **is one plus the year is given, for example, if we talk about the year 2019 we say we are in 21st century (20+1) and if we talk about **1672 then it is 17th century (16+1).**

questions.question: Which base is present in milk of magnesia?
questions.solution:
• The base present in the milk of magnesia is Magnesium hydroxide.
 
• It is a white solid with low solubility in water and a common component of antacids.
 
• As an antacid, magnesium hydroxide works by simple neutralization, where the hydroxide ions combine with acidic H+ ions in the stomach to produce water.

• __**Article 124 **__deals with the appointment of Judges of Supreme court.

questions.question: In humans, the sound is produced by the ________.
questions.solution: The larynx is usually called the voice box because it is where sound comes from. It is the one that manages the pitch and volume produced by mammals, and it is also the one that houses the vocal folds.

questions.question: The queen with the title Didda ruled over which part of India between 980 - 1003?
questions.solution: Didda was a daughter of Simharāja, the king of Lohara who ruled Kashmir from 958 CE to 1003 CE. She married the king of Kashmir, Ksemagupta, thus uniting the kingdom of Lohara with that of her husband.

questions.question: The vocal cords in men are about _______ long.
questions.solution: Men and women have different vocal fold sizes. The male vocal folds are about 20 mm in length while Female vocal folds are between 12.5 mm and 17.5 mm long. The difference in vocal fold size between men and women means that their voices have a different pitch.

questions.question: During their rule the British persuaded or forced cultivators in Madras to grow __________.

questions.question: __________ says that if we keep increasing the employment of an input, with other inputs fixed, eventually a point will be reached after which the resulting addition to output (i.e., marginal product of that input) will start falling.
questions.solution: Law of diminishing marginal product states that while increasing one input and keeping other inputs at the same level may initially increase output, further increases in that input will have a limited effect, and eventually no effect or a negative effect, on output.

questions.question: The first formed primary xylem elements are called ___________.
questions.solution: Protoxylem is the part of the primary xylem that develops first, consisting of narrow, thin-walled cells. It matures much before the plant organ has completed their elongation and is smaller in diameter as compared to Metaxylem.

questions.question: Nereis, Pheretima (Earthworm) and Hirudinaria (blood sucking leech) are examples of which Phylum?
questions.solution:
__**Explanation:**__

__
 
• **Nereis**,** Pheretima (Earthworm)** and** Hirudinaria** are examples of Annelida Phylum.
 
• The annelids are also known as the **ringed worms** and are bilaterally symmetrical, triploblastic, coelomate, invertebrate organisms.
 
• **Other important features of Annelids are**

 
• They may be aquatic (marine and fresh water) or terrestrial; free-living, and sometimes parasitic.
 
• They exhibit organ-system level of body organisation and bilateral symmetry.
 
• They are triploblastic, metamerically segmented and coelomate animals.
 
• Their body surface is distinctly marked out into segments or metameres and, hence, the phylum name Annelida

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Coelenterata**:

 
• They are aquatic, mostly marine, sessile or free-swimming, radially symmetrical animals
 
• The characteristic feature of this phylum is the presence of cnidoblasts or cnidocytes (which contain the stinging capsules or nematocysts) present on the tentacles and the body.
 
• Cnidoblasts are used for anchorage, defence, and for capture of prey. Eg.** Physalia** (Portuguese man-of-war), **Adamsia** (Sea anemone),** Pennatula** (Sea-pen), **Gorgonia** (Sea-fan), and **Meandrina** (Brain coral)

**Aschelminthes:**

 
• The body of the aschelminthes is circular in cross-section, hence, the name **roundworms**
 
• They may be freeliving, aquatic and terrestrial or parasitic in plants and animals.
 
• Roundworms have organ-system level of body organisation.
 
• They are bilaterally symmetrical, triploblastic and pseudocoelomate animals.
 
• Examples : **Ascaris** (Roundworm), **Wuchereria **(Filaria worm), **Ancylostoma** (Hookworm).

questions.question: What is the difference (in Rs.) between the compound interests on Rs. 4000 for 1 year at 12% per annum compounded yearly and half - yearly?
questions.solution:
Compound interest if it was compounded annually can be given as

⇒ CI = 4000{(1 + 12/100) - 1}

⇒ CI = 480

Compound interest if it was compounded half yearly can be given as

⇒ CI = 4000{(1 + 6/100)² - 1} = 4000{(1.06)² - 1}

⇒ CI = 4000 × 0.1236 = 494.4

So, difference = 494.4 - 480 = 14.4

questions.question: A can finish a work in 18 days and B in 36 days. If they work on it together for 9 days, then what percent of work is left?
questions.solution:
Work done by A in 1 day = 1/18th of total work

Work done by B in 1 day = 1/36th of total work

If the work together for 9 days, % of work left by them can be written as

⇒ [1 - 9 × {(1/18) + 1/36}] × 100

⇒ (1 - 1/2 - 1/4) × 100 = 100/4 = 25%

∴ The percentage of work left by them is 25%

questions.question: The sum of a fraction and 7 times its reciprocal is 11/2. What is the fraction?
questions.solution:
Let the fraction be y

According to the problem statement

⇒ y + 7/y = 11/2

⇒ 2y² + 14 - 11y = 0

⇒ (y - 7/2)(y - 2) = 0

the required fraction is 7/2 which satisfies the above given condition

∴ the value of required fraction is 7/2

questions.question: If on a Sale there is 30% discount on the marked price of Rs. 2500, but the sale is done at Rs. 1400 only. What additional discount (in %) did the customer get?
questions.solution:
Price after 30% discount can be given as

⇒ Price after 30 % discount = 2500 × (1 - 30/100) = Rs. 1750

But it was sold for Rs. 1400

additional discount = 1750 - 1400 = 350

Discount percentage can be given as

⇒ Discount percentage = 350 × 100/1750 = 20%

∴ The additional discount is 20%

questions.question: To travel 432 km, an Express train takes 1 hour more than Duronto. If however, the speed of the Express train is increased by 50%, it takes 2 hours less than Duronto. What is the speed (in km/hr) of Duronto train?
questions.solution:
Let the speed of Duronto train be y km/hr and that of Express train be z km/hr

According to the problem statement

⇒ 432/y + 1 = 432/z

⇒ 1/z = 1/y + 1/432 ----(i)

If speed of Express train increased by 50%, now the speed will be 1.5 z,

Now

⇒ 432/1.5z + 2 = 432/y Using (i)

⇒ 288(1/y + 1/432) + 2 = 432/y

⇒ 288/y + 2/3 + 2 = 432/y

⇒ y = 54 km/hr

∴ the speed of Duronto train is 54 km/hr

questions.question: If the profits are added to the company's reserves and the reserves stood at Rs 150 lakhs at the end of 2015, what were the reserves (in Rs. lakhs) in the beginning of 2012?
questions.solution:
Profit from 2012 to 2015 = 30 - 10 + 5 + 15 = 40 lakhs

Reserve at the beginning of 2012 = 150 - 40 = 110 lakhs

∴ the reserve at the beginning of 2012 is Rs. 110 lakhs

questions.question: In a class of 50 students there are 27 boys. The average weight of these boys is 72 Kg and average weight of the full class is 55.44 kgs. What is the average weight (in kgs) of the girls of the class?
questions.solution:
Number of girls in the class can be given as 23 (i.e. 50 - 27)

Average weight of boys is 72

⇒ sum of weight of boys/27 = 72

⇒ sum of weight of boys = 27 × 72 = 1944 ----(i)

Average weight of all students is 55.44

⇒ (Sum of weight of boys + sum of weight of girls)/50 = 55.44

⇒ (Sum of weight of boys + sum of weight of girls) = 55.44 × 50 = 2772 Using (i)

⇒ sum of weight of girls = 2772 - 1944 = 828

Average weight of girls can be given as

⇒ average weight of girls = sum of weight of girls/23 = 828/23 = 36

∴ The average weight of girls is 36 kgs

questions.question:
**In the following question, a sentence has been given in Direct/Indirect speech. Out of the four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Indirect/Direct speech.**

Mother said, "Will you tell me what it means, Pritam?"

options.text: Mother asked Pritam if he will tell her what it meant
Mother asked Pritam that he would tell her what it meant
Mother asked Pritam if he would tell her what it meant
Mother asked Pritam that he will tell her what it meant

questions.solution:
The correct answer is- __**Mother asked Pritam if he would tell her what it meant**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**​

 
• Let's look at the steps to change the sentence from direct to indirect speech:
 
• The tense of direct speech is changed only when the reporting verb is in the past tense.
 
• When the direct speech is in an interrogative form, we follow the steps given below:
 
 
• The reporting verb said to is converted into asked.
 
• Connectors 'whether' or 'if' are used in place of comma and inverted commas.
 
• Change the reported speech from interrogative to assertive.
 
• The personal pronouns will be changed according to the subject and object of the reporting verb.
 
• ​Here the 2nd person 'you' will change into the 3rd person 'he' as per the object.
 
• Similarly 'me' is converted into 'her' as per the subject.
 
• The auxiliary verb (will) in direct speech changes to (would).
 
• **Present Indefinite tense **is changed into **past indefinite tense. (means-meant)**
 
 
 
• ​At last line up the remaining part.

 
 
• 
 
Following these steps, we finally get- *Mother asked Pritam if he would tell her what it meant*
